title: Fertilizer Application Window
description: Low rainfall probability (10%) and moderate winds (8 km/h) on Wednesday, May 13. Ideal for top dressing maize fields.
recommendedAction: Apply Urea at 200kg/ha for maize. Apply early morning when temperatures are cooler.

title: Supplementary Irrigation Required
description: Only 2 days with meaningful rainfall in the 7-day forecast. Soil moisture may drop below 40% field capacity.
recommendedAction: Apply 25mm of water using drip or furrow irrigation early morning.

title: Increased Fall Armyworm Risk
description: Humidity > 75% and temperatures > 28°C expected for 3 consecutive days. High risk of fall armyworm activity.
recommendedAction: Scout maize fields for egg masses and early instar larvae. Deploy pheromone traps.

title: Livestock Heat Stress Alert
description: Temperature expected to reach 37°C on Friday. High risk of heat stress for cattle and poultry.
recommendedAction: Ensure shade and extra water for livestock. Avoid handling during peak heat.
